senses.gloss: m. (formed from כְּדֵי, v. דַּי) adequate, worthy, competent, deserving.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 76:5">Gen. R. s. 76</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 32:11">Gen. XXXII, 11</cite>) <he>איני כ׳</he> I am not deserving (of any of all the mercies); <he>כ׳ אני אבל וכ׳</he> I am worthy (of some) but too small for all &c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 165b:14">B. Bath. 165ᵇ</cite> <he>אני איני כ׳ שאתם וכ׳</he> I do not deserve the honor of having that question put to me by you.
<cite ref="Gittin 90b:4">Gitt. 90ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 5:9">Tosef. Sot. V, 9</cite> <he>כ׳ הוא במיתה</he> he deserves death.

Ber. 9ᵃ, a. fr. the authority of כ׳ הוא וכ׳ R. … is sufficient to be relied upon &c.; a. fr.—Pl. כְּדָאִים, כְּדָאִין, כְּדָיִין. Mekh. Yithro, Amalek, s. 1 אין אנו ב׳ שישמשנו (ed. Weiss כְּדָיִן) we are not worthy to be served by him; a. e.—Fem. כְּדָאִית.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:5">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite> <he>איני כ׳ לשפחתו</he> I am not worthy to be his handmaid.
